subject: gk
question: Fa-Hien visited India during the reign of which of the following Gupta Kings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The famous Chinese pilgrim Fa-Hien visited India during the reign of Chandragupta II.
 
• Chandragupta II adopted the titles **Sakari and Vikramaditya.**
 
• Chandragupta II conquered Western Malwa and Gujarat, from the Shaka Kshatrapas Rudrasena III.
 
• He issued **silver coins** in the memory of the **victory over Sakas.**
 
• He was the **first Gupta ruler to issue silver coins**
 
• Ujjain made the second capital by Chandragupta II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gupta Period (319 AD-540 AD):
 
 
• Chandragupta I was the first Gupta ruler to assume the title of Maharajadhiraja. 
 
• He established his authority over **Magadha, Saketa and Prayaga.**
 
• **Samudragupta** was the **greatest king of the Gupta dynasty.**
 
• Samudragupta’s military campaigns justify description of him as the **Napoleon of India **by V.A. Smith.
